position: Abuse protection is visible and data-minimal
headline: The preview can slow repeated requests without retaining what a learner asked.
copy: This is instance-local prototype protection. Production needs a distributed limiter, alerting, retention policy, on-call ownership, and incident response.

postures.title: Rate window
postures.copy: The default private-preview limit is explicit and testable.

postures.title: Raw questions
postures.copy: Question text never enters monitoring events.

postures.title: Raw IP
postures.copy: The guard accepts a private client token and stores only a short one-way bucket.

postures.title: Retention
postures.copy: Only bounded instance memory is retained.

postures.title: Production ops
postures.copy: Distributed state, alerting, and incident response remain unbuilt.

flow.title: Bucket
flow.copy: Create a short pseudonymous client and time bucket.

flow.title: Limit
flow.copy: Allow a bounded number of requests in the current window.

flow.title: Record
flow.copy: Store route, outcome, and status class only.

flow.title: Discard
flow.copy: Lose all monitor state when the instance stops.

decisions.label: Telemetry consent
decisions.reason: The prototype does not create learner analytics.

decisions.label: Operational event
decisions.reason: Only service health fields are represented.

decisions.label: Public service
decisions.reason: A local limiter is not production abuse prevention.

locks.title: Deployment lock
locks.copy: No provider endpoint, domain, secret, or production runtime is activated.

locks.title: Write lock
locks.copy: No source, rights, reviewer, or learner write route exists.

locks.title: Identity lock
locks.copy: Role simulations do not authenticate a person or grant production access.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: Evidence-ready candidates remain blocked from publication and registry merge.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: Pilot readiness evidence cannot activate an invitation or public service.

packet:
Rate Limit & Privacy-Safe Monitoring v4.8.8
Default: 12 requests per minute per pseudonymous bucket.
Stored: route, status class, outcome, time bucket.
Not stored: question, IP, referrer, user agent.
